name: Glasscubes
description_en:
Glasscubes currently centers on collecting client information for accounting firms: staff create itemized requests, clients supply replies and files, and the firm follows missing responses and reminders from one place. Its broader workspaces also support forms and document approvals, but those workflows have different access conditions.

The useful evaluation is a complete request cycle, including a missing item and a stalled reminder, rather than a generic checklist of chat and project features. This draft distinguishes client link replies from workspace membership, AI checking from professional review, and subscription price displays from total contractual cost.
description_zh:
Glasscubes 当前聚焦会计师事务所的客户资料收集：员工建立分项请求，客户回复并提交文件，事务所集中跟踪缺项及提醒。更广的工作区也支持表单和文档审批，但这些流程的访问条件不同。

适合评估的是一个完整资料请求周期，包括缺项及提醒停滞，而非泛化聊天和项目功能清单。本稿区分客户链接回复与工作区成员资格、AI 检查与专业复核，以及订阅页面显示价格与合同总成本。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect responses against named items with supporting instructions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按具名条目及说明收集回复。

core_features.explanation_en: Track overdue requests and reminder exhaustion rather than treating email delivery as a response.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪逾期和提醒耗尽，不把邮件送达当作回复。

core_features.explanation_en: Review uncertain items and draft follow-up before relying on an automated check.
core_features.explanation_zh: 依赖自动检查前复核不确定条目及后续草稿。

en: Evaluate one client information cycle from item list through missing responses, reminder exhaustion and export.
zh: 评估一个客户资料周期，从条目清单到缺失回复、提醒耗尽及导出。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation, not observed adoption or measured efficiency.

Service scope.en: Hosted client-information workflow; API availability is a pricing-page claim, not a tested integration.
Service scope.zh: 托管客户资料流程；API 可用性属于价格页说明，未测试集成。

specific_roles: Payroll or audit team managing missing client items

steps.en: Confirm plan and recipient access model, then prepare a non-sensitive itemized request with distinct client copies where required.
steps.zh: 确认套餐和收件人访问模型，再准备非敏感分项请求，需要时为各客户建立独立副本。

steps.en: Inspect the reminder schedule and completion evidence, then check export contents before relying on the workflow.
steps.zh: 检查提醒日程及完成证据，再核对导出内容后依赖该流程。

integrations.scope: Open API advertised; no API credentials, spec, connector direction or quota tested.

items.en: Shared recipients, forced-submitted status, stopped reminders and workspace invitations require distinct review.
items.zh: 共享收件人、强制已提交状态、停止提醒及工作区邀请需分别核对。

supported_languages.scope: English public documentation read; no UI locale coverage established.

license.scope: Subscription rights only; vendor retains proprietary service rights and restricts reverse engineering; no self-hosting grant established.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: GBP account plus user subscription; Monthly and Annually displays are detailed in the cost section. External-client unit, bulk-distribution charge and checkout not verified. No sustained-free plan established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 英镑账户费加用户订阅费，Monthly 和 Annually 显示详见费用节。外部客户单位、批量分发收费和结账未核实；未确立可持续免费套餐。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Choose shared or separate requests before sending
sections.title_zh: 发送前选择共享请求或独立副本
sections.en: A proposed payroll collection starts with one line per required item, supporting instructions and a due date. Several recipients can contribute to one shared request; the duplicate option instead creates a separate request for each recipient. Those choices suit different confidentiality needs, so do not assume that entering multiple addresses isolates the responses. Sending to a non-member email address requires Essential, Professional or Advantage. Optional temporary email codes and SMS verification are documented, not a guarantee that every request uses them.
sections.zh: 假设收集工资资料，可先按每个所需条目一行输入，再补充说明和到期日。多名收件人可共同回复一个共享请求；复制选项则为每人建立独立请求。两者适合不同保密要求，因此不能认为输入多个邮箱便隔离了回复。向非成员邮箱发送请求需 Essential、Professional 或 Advantage。文档提供可选临时邮件码和短信验证，不代表每项请求均启用。

sections.title_en: Completion is a workflow state that still needs review
sections.title_zh: 完成是仍需复核的流程状态
sections.en: Clients follow an emailed request link, answer individual items with text/files and can delegate an item. A submitted item can be edited; a completed request can be reopened through a time-sensitive emailed link. The firm can also respond on someone’s behalf. Crucially, the firm can mark a request submitted despite incomplete answers. Check the actual items before treating the status as substantive completion. Archiving removes the recipient’s ability to view or respond.
sections.zh: 客户通过邮件中的请求链接，用文字／文件逐项回复，也可委托别人处理某项。已提交条目可编辑，已完成请求可通过限时邮件链接重新访问；事务所也可代为回复。关键在于，管理方即使未收到完整答案，也能把请求标为已提交。应核对实际条目，再把状态视为实质完成。归档会移除收件人的查看和回复能力。

sections.title_en: Treat a stopped chase as an action queue
sections.title_zh: 把停止催收的请求作为待处理队列
sections.en: The October20,2026 reminder page describes one pre-deadline reminder chosen by deadline distance, followed by three reminders four days apart by default. The creation guide instead lists five days, two days and the due date when time permits. Preserve that documentation difference and inspect the actual schedule; templates can override it. Completion, hold, archive, disabled reminders and email unsubscribe can stop follow-up. A bounced email or exhausted schedule needs human attention. A Delivered label only reflects a receipt from certain mail servers, not proof the client read or supplied anything.
sections.zh: 2026年10月20日提醒页描述：根据距截止时间选择一次到期前提醒，默认再发送三次逾期提醒，间隔四天；创建指南却列出时间允许时在到期前五天、两天及当天提醒。应保留这项文档差异，并检查实际日程；模板可覆盖它。完成、暂停、归档、关闭提醒及邮件退订均可停止跟进。退信或提醒耗尽需要人工处理。Delivered 只反映某些邮件服务器的回执，不证明客户已读或已提供资料。

sections.title_en: An uncertain document is not an accepted tax input
sections.title_zh: 不确定的文档不等于已接受的税务资料
sections.en: For personal tax, AI checking can compare uploaded material with requested items and last year’s information, then ask the client one question at a time. The documented states include uncertainty. AI Assist can summarize, extract tables and draft follow-up; drafts require review before reaching the client, and firms can turn off Assist or client checking. Evaluate a deliberately ambiguous sample and retain a staff decision about the missing item. No tax accuracy, autonomous filing or compliance outcome was tested. Model providers, AI retention, training use and usage quotas were not established by the read pages.
sections.zh: 个人税务场景中，AI 检查可把上传资料与请求条目、上一年信息比较，再逐次询问客户；文档状态包括不确定。AI Assist 可摘要、提取表格并草拟跟进，发送给客户前需复核，事务所可关闭 Assist 或客户检查。可用刻意含糊的样本评估，并由员工决定缺项。本研究未测试税务准确性、自主申报或合规结果；所读页面未确立模型供应商、AI 保留、训练使用及用量配额。

sections.title_en: A no-account reply does not mean no-account approval
sections.title_zh: 无需账户回复不等于无需账户审批
sections.en:
The external file-approval guide requires permission to invite an external person. Sending that approval invites them into the workspace as a Contributor; they provide a name and password and join before responding. That is a different access path from an information-request link. Approve may include feedback, whereas reject requires a reason. This article does not establish the legal effect of every electronic signature.

Reusable workspace request templates can be managed by Owners and Contributors; account templates require an Administrator. Forms can create tasks, notify members and save a PDF. A multipart form configured for manual progression waits until someone sends or completes the next part; a submission alone does not finish every downstream action.
sections.zh:
外部文件审批指南要求具备邀请外部人员的权限。发送该审批会邀请对方以 Contributor 加入工作区；对方提供姓名、密码并加入后才回复。这与资料请求链接是不同访问路径。批准可附反馈，拒绝则须说明理由；该文章不确立所有电子签名的法律效力。

Owner 和 Contributor 可管理可复用的工作区请求模板，账户模板需 Administrator。表单可创建任务、通知成员并保存 PDF。配置为手动推进的多段表单，须有人发送或完成下一段才继续；收到一次提交不代表全部后续动作已完成。

sections.title_en: Budget the account charge as well as the seats
sections.title_zh: 预算包含账户费和席位费
sections.en:
The public GBP pricing switch shows these monthly account/user amounts: Monthly — Essential £120 plus £18 per user, Professional £180 plus £22, Advantage £360 plus £38. Annually — monthly equivalents of £96 plus £14.40, £144 plus £17.60, and £288 plus £30.40 respectively. UK VAT is additional where applicable; 50+ users are directed to volume pricing. Essential makes bulk distribution optional, Professional includes it and highlights forms/approvals, and Advantage highlights a white-labelled portal.

Seat eligibility, external-client charging and optional distribution fees need a quote. The old directory’s dollar starting price is superseded. A public API is advertised in the plan comparison, but its authentication, scopes, limits and write behavior were not researched or executed.
sections.zh:
公开英镑价格切换显示以下每月账户费／用户费：Monthly：Essential £120 加每用户 £18，Professional £180 加 £22，Advantage £360 加 £38；Annually 对应月度等价值依次为 £96 加 £14.40、£144 加 £17.60、£288 加 £30.40。适用时另加英国 VAT，50 名以上用户需询量价。Essential 的批量分发可选，Professional 包含该服务并突出表单／审批，Advantage 突出白标门户。

席位资格、外部客户收费及可选分发费需询价。旧目录的美元起价已被替代。套餐表宣传公开 API，但本研究未核查或执行其认证、权限、限额及写操作。

sections.title_en: Available storage and cancellability need contractual limits
sections.title_zh: 可用存储和取消订阅须结合合同限制
sections.en: Do not read unlimited storage available as unlimited included storage. Terms specify an Advantage allowance of 500GB plus 50GB per internal user and separately charged excess. Annual fees are prepaid and renew automatically; users above the contracted number do not receive the annual discount. The marketing no-annual-commitment phrase does not remove these terms. Termination requires 30 days’ written notice and an opportunity for an exit interview; customer cancellation has no prorated refund. Arrange an exit before cancelling: terms put backup responsibility on the customer and do not promise post-termination forwarding, while the data-processing schedule separately addresses return/deletion.
sections.zh: 不应把“可提供无限存储”理解为无限内含存储。条款给 Advantage 的额度为 500GB 加每名内部用户 50GB，超额另收费。年费预付并自动续订，超过合同用户数的用户费不享年付折扣。营销中的“无年度承诺”不取消这些条款。终止需提前三十天书面通知，并提供退出访谈机会；客户取消不按比例退款。应先安排退出副本再取消：条款要求客户负责备份，不承诺终止后转交内容，数据处理附表另述返还／删除。

sections.title_en: Separate a response export from a restorable workspace
sections.title_zh: 区分回复导出与可恢复工作区
sections.en:
A request can be downloaded as a ZIP with its responses and text rendered to PDF; reporting CSV captures status. Form exports separately provide submitted information and progress in Excel. Inspect those outputs against the intended records rather than assuming a full workspace restore, audit history or permission round trip. Only workspace owners can permanently delete requests from Trash; the retention window was not established.

The privacy policy distinguishes uploaded account content stored in UK datacentres from other personal data processed in the UK, Germany and Ireland. Its seven-day account-use retention category and longer contractual records are not a universal file-recovery window. Confirm the actual AI processing scope before using sensitive client documents. No account, request, invitation, upload, AI call, export, purchase or cancellation was performed.
sections.zh:
请求可下载 ZIP，包含回复及呈现为 PDF 的文字；报告 CSV 记录状态。表单另可导出提交信息和 Excel 进度。应按拟保留的记录检查这些输出，不假设能完整恢复工作区、审计历史或权限。只有工作区 Owner 可永久删除回收站请求，保留窗口未确立。

隐私政策区分英国数据中心保存的账户上传内容，与在英国、德国和爱尔兰处理的其他个人数据。其账户使用类数据七天保留及更长合同记录期限，不是所有文件的恢复窗口。敏感客户文档使用前应确认实际 AI 处理范围。本研究未执行账户、请求、邀请、上传、AI 调用、导出、付款或取消。

seo.title_en: Glasscubes: Client Requests, Reminders, Access and Total Cost
seo.title_zh: Glasscubes：客户资料请求、提醒、访问及总成本
seo.description_en: Assess itemized client replies, AI uncertainty, approval membership, stopped reminders and account-plus-user fees.
seo.description_zh: 评估客户分项回复、AI 不确定状态、审批成员要求、停止提醒及账户加用户费用。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate a client information collection workflow for an accounting firm.
secondary_questions: Do client replies and document approvals use the same access path?
What is included in the storage and subscription price?
seo.query_basis: Editorial questions; no measured demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No account operations, client reply, verification, upload, approval, AI quality, export/restore, billing or cancellation tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户操作、客户回复、验证、上传、审批、AI 质量、导出／恢复、计费或取消。

research_gaps.en: Reminder default text differs across current pages; confirm actual schedule. External seat billing, optional service rates, storage overage, e-signature scope, AI providers/retention/training/quotas and API details unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前页面的默认提醒描述不同，需确认实际日程。外部席位收费、可选服务费、存储超额费、电子签名范围、AI 供应商／保留／训练／配额及 API 细节未核实。

research_gaps.en: Full restorable backup, Trash window, contract-specific deletion/return implementation, mobile/offline behavior and language coverage not established.
research_gaps.zh: 完整可恢复备份、回收站窗口、具体合同删除／返还实现、移动／离线行为及语言范围未确立。
